title: Understanding the Scatterplot
text: Look at the pattern of the data points in the scatterplot. Consider how the function f(x) might transform the x-values to fit the y-values shown.

title: Exploring Function $$f(x)=-x$$
text: Think about how the function $$f(x)=-x$$ would affect the x-values. What happens to the y-values when you apply this transformation?

title: Checking Function $$f(x)=-x$$
text: Does the transformation $$f(x)=-x$$ create a linear relationship between $$x$$ and $$y$$ in the scatterplot?
